hint.return: Bring the item back and both of you confirm it here.

photos.title: Photos of the item
photos.hint: Photos of the item's condition help if anything goes wrong.

confirm.WITHDRAW: Withdraw your request? The owner will be told.

confirm.ALL_FINE: Everything is in order? The deposit goes back to the renter in full.
confirm.ACCEPT_DAMAGE: Accept the damage claim? The whole deposit goes to the owner.
confirm.MARK_HANDED_OVER: Confirm you gave the item to the renter?
confirm.MARK_RETURNED: Confirm you gave the item back?

dialog.REPORT_NOT_RECEIVED: The item was not handed over

lead.DECLINE: The renter sees your reason. It is optional.
lead.CANCEL: The other side sees your reason. If the deal is paid, everything goes back to the renter.
lead.REPORT_NOT_RECEIVED: This opens a dispute. An administrator decides; your money stays safe until then.
lead.REPORT_NOT_RETURNED: This opens a dispute. An administrator decides; the deposit stays frozen until then.
lead.REJECT_DAMAGE: This opens a dispute. An administrator looks at the photos and decides.
